column1: # Package ownership, coverage floors and stub probes.
# Read by three devtool readers — one lint sub-check and two tasks:
#   stubskips              — lint sub-check: a Rule W-1 behaviour skip is a merge blocker only for
#   cover                  — task: a package is exempt from its floor until its owner lands; the
#                            landed subplans are listed in tools/devtool/cover.go's landedSubplans
#   gen-contract-fixtures  — task: refuses to record a behaviour fixture while the owner's impl is
# floor is the §6.4 line-coverage floor. probe names the method isStub() calls to decide whether
# the package is still a stub; "-" means the package has no stub phase (SP-01 implements it now).
# A package that exists on disk but is absent from this file fails
# `go test ./test/guards -run TestV1_StubGraphIsInertAndOwned` (the ci.yml `test` job): a new
# package cannot appear without an ownership decision. The enforcer is that TEST, not devtool lint
# — no lint sub-check checks disk correspondence, and stubskips deliberately ignores the exit
# status of the `go test` run it greps, so a failure there would leave `devtool lint` green.
# Adding a package therefore means: a row here, an entry in tools/devtool/importrules.go (§3.2),
